subject: Shareholder update narrative — lock storyline & QBR readiness
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, Adam Sanchez <adam.sanchez@vclp.com>
Cc: Board Relations <board@venturelp.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Jun 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Shareholder update narrative — lock storyline & QBR readiness

Team — attaching the working draft of the shareholder/investor update (draft_slide_v2.pptx) and a short pull-quote doc on the narrative. I want to get the storyline locked by EOD Thursday so we can ship the packet to Venture Lake by Friday morning.

Key asks in this pass:
- Product: confirm the latency and throughput improvements slide (slide 8) — we need validated 90-day numbers and the annotation around batching/quantization wins.
- Finance: final ARR/NRR numbers (I pulled preliminarys but need verified values).
- Ops/Platform: confirm SLA baseline and the 'fallback behavior' bullets on slide 12 (sla_metrics.xlsx attached).
- Comms/CEO note: short opening paragraph (2-3 lines) that sets the posture on growth + discipline.

Please add only line edits or notes directly in the deck for content changes (comment mode) and upload an annotated PDF if you want to preserve comments (see recommended filename pattern). If you have structural pushback, call it out in the body with suggested replacement language.

Deadline: EOD Thursday 6/3 for line edits. If you need more time, say so now and propose a concrete alternative.

Attachments: draft_slide_v2.pptx, sla_metrics.xlsx

Neha
Neha Kapoor
Head of Product Strategy | Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 01 Jun 2027 10:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Shareholder update narrative — lock storyline & QBR readiness

Thanks Neha — I pulled a pass and attached line-level comments (slideline_comments_annotated.pdf). High-level notes: 

1) Narrative: prefer we frame the growth story as 'durable unit-economics-led expansion' rather than pure topline growth. Suggest changing the one-liner on slide 2 to: "Scaling responsibly: driving ARR growth while improving operational unit economics."

2) Metrics to confirm before lock:
  - ARR and NRR: include trailing 12-mo and QoQ % (we need finance to confirm).
  - Latency chart (slide 8): request raw sample sizes and percentile definitions (p50/p90/p99). Ops, can you add an inline note on methodology?
  - CAC/Payback: if we can't include both in the deck, include CAC only in the appendix and call it out on slide 5.

3) Slide flow: move the 'risk mitigations' slide earlier (right after the product slide) — board likes to see mitigations close to technical progress.

I've added specific callouts on slides 5, 8, and 12. Also attached a one-page annotated export (slideline_comments_annotated.pdf). I can take the CEO note draft once we have final ARR numbers.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Corporate Communications | Redwood Inference
Attachments: slideline_comments_annotated.pdf
From: Adam Sanchez <adam.sanchez@vclp.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Board Relations <board@venturelp.com>
Date: Wed, 02 Jun 2027 08:19:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Shareholder update narrative — lock storyline & QBR readiness

Neha / Marissa — thanks for the draft and clear asks. Two quick items from our side: 

1) Timeline: Friday EOD (6/4) final deck delivery to the board would be ideal; we understand internal lock Thursday EOD and can accept that. If you need to shift to Monday for any reason, flag now.

2) Appendix request: could you add a one-slide 'risk mitigation' appendix that briefly covers (a) supply/capacity fallback (how you degrade gracefully), (b) data retention/compliance posture, and (c) churn mitigation playbook? We typically like one concrete example per bullet.

3) CEO note: board would appreciate a short CEO opener that addresses governance oversight and the QBR asks in 2-3 sentences. If you can route a CEO draft by Thursday morning we can absorb it into the final packet.

Happy to jump on a 15-min sync if aligning on the mitigation language is easier live.

—Adam Sanchez
Partner, Venture Lake Partners
adam.sanchez@vclp.com
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Adam Sanchez <adam.sanchez@vclp.com>, Board Relations <board@venturelp.com>
Date: Thu, 03 Jun 2027 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Shareholder update narrative — lock storyline & QBR readiness

Acknowledged — thank you all. Quick tasking based on comments:

- Jonas: please validate the latency methodology and paste a 3-line note we can include under the chart (deadline: Thu 2pm PT). Attachment: sla_metrics.xlsx for reference.
- Tessa: move the risk mitigations slide to follow slide 8 and draft 3 brief examples (deadline: Thu 3pm PT).
- Marissa: incorporate the narrative tweak and fold in one-line CEO options (send 2 variants; deadline: Thu 12pm PT).
- Finance (copied separately): please confirm ARR/NRR/YoY numbers by Thu 5pm PT — if we don't have finals we'll call out preliminarys with a footnote.

I'll compile annotated versions and publish an export to the Drive link below for final review. If there's major disagreement on flow, escalate to me by noon Thursday. Otherwise we'll treat Thursday EOD as lock.

Drive link: https://drive.redd.in/shareholder/update-draft-v2

Thanks — Neha
